crossRefs.note: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”
She fell at his feet, and said, “On me, my lord, on me be the blame! Please let your servant speak in your ears. Hear…

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: He came near to her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” He answered, “I am.” Then she said to him, “Hear the words of your servant.” He answered, “I’m listening.”
translations.bsb: When he had come near to her, the woman asked, “Are you Joab?” “I am,” he replied. “Listen to the words of your servant,” she said. “I am listening,” he answered.
translations.kjv: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.
translations.asv: And he came near unto her; and the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thy handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.
